component.name: BONK
component.summary: A mighty command-line tool for bonking your friends, enemies, or inanimate objects

description.p: BONK is a fun command-line tool that allows you to "bonk" anybody or anything with the power of your terminal! Keep track of exactly how many times you've bonked anything with persistent cloud-based bonking statistics.

ul.li: BONK anybody or anything with the power of your command-line!
Display delightful ASCII art with each successful BONK
Online bonking records powered by BONK-api to spread your bonks around the globe
Blazingly Fast and efficient bonking, written in Go
